content:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xx across eu-west2->apac routing tier (detected 09:03 UTC). Autoswitching observed — several flows flipped to lower-tier endpoints. Paging SRE oncall. :rotating_light:

samir: saw the alert, confirming increased error rate and client retries. Lots of TLS handshake failures upstream.

joanne: i'm on pager, grabbing handoff from samir. Samir status?

samir: taking quick look — metrics show routing-policy rollback events around 09:02:51, probe failures in apac edge, traffic got redistributed to fallback tier. Not all requests fail, ~18% 5xx in last 5m for APAC-origin.

mike: tagging runbook: routing->policy-failover.joanne please follow the emergency steps if you decide to rollback.

joanne: ack. oncall handoff — samir handing to me. Samir, anything to call out for config?

samir: policy id rp-78a2 had a recent operator change (promo weight adjustment). suspect race between promo rollout and health-check sampling.

joanne: ok applying emergency overlay: pin traffic back to eu-west2 primary and disable tier fallback for affected prefix. Doing canary first.

carla: notifying support — customers in APAC seeing errors on inference endpoints, some 10s of requests/min failing. Support channel prepped.

joanne: executing rollback command now (dry-run then apply):
```
redwoodctl routing policy rollback --policy rp-78a2 --to-version 11 --scope region=apac --dry-run=false
```

mike: FYI telemetry shows DNS TTLs are normal (60s) but some edge caches had stale steering flags. Might need to flush edge config after rollback.

dinesh: prepping edge flush. Running:
```
edge-flush --region apac --routes rp-78a2 --confirm
```

joanne: rollback applied, monitoring results. 5xx dropping to baseline in last 30s.

incident-bot: NOTE: rollback executed by joanne at 09:08 UTC. Auto-escalation cancelled.

carla: customer impact estimate: ~72 customers experienced errors, top affected: partner-A (30%), partner-B (15%). Support drafting notification.

mike: leaving a short mitigation note in runbook: avoid concurrent promo weight pushes during health-check window; add short lock for policy edits.

samir: can we add a quick guard in control plane to reject overlapping promos for same prefix within 2m?

joanne: creating a follow-up ticket. Also scheduling a blameless postmortem with oncall + policy team.

dinesh: completed edge flush at 09:10 UTC, caches cleared. No more tier flips in telemetry.

support-bot: Customer notification draft ready (will post to status.redwood): "Intermittent 5xx affecting APAC-origin traffic between 09:02–09:10 UTC due to routing policy glitch. Services are recovered after rollback. We are investigating and will update."

carla: posting message now.

mike: next steps: 1) postmortem, 2) implement config-lock, 3) add anomaly alert for rapid policy-change events.

joanne: handing back to samir for follow-up and postmortem lead. Samir taking it.

samir: I’ll own the postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
